scope: Synthetic fixture only; no real WeChat account, database or key accessed.

build.scope: Build only; no key, decrypt, or real-data operation is executed.

assertions: Every authenticated multi-page database is decrypted and can be queried by the real data bridge.
The final directory is absent while private plaintext already exists; a single RENAME_EXCL rename publishes the complete directory.
A destination created concurrently is preserved without overwrite.
SIGTERM while decrypting or awaiting key stdin returns IMPORT_CANCELED and leaves no private temporary output.
Added database shards, directories and ordinary files invalidate the in-progress import.
FIFO, symlink, active sidecar, overlapping source/output paths, incorrect key, modified HMAC, truncated and all-zero pages fail.
Question mark, fragment and percent characters remain filesystem path data in SQLite URI.
Oversized second stdin lines, trailing JSON and malformed keys are rejected without key logging.

limitations: Manual valid key and already-quiescent offline encrypted copy required.
Fixed macOS WeChat v4 SQLCipher4 profile only.
SIGKILL, crashes or power loss cannot guarantee Go defer cleanup; the engine must own its job directory lifecycle.
Atomic directory visibility is not a crash-durability guarantee.
Not hardened against every same-user hostile instantaneous path swap.
Key byte buffers are wiped; Go string and crypto-internal copies are not guaranteed to be erased.
128 GiB per database and 512 GiB total are input limits, not measured capacity or performance.
No real-data compatibility or full Alpha feature-parity claim.
